#Plourde next steps - in a loop 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

station_data <- Integrated_new |>                #Creating a station_data df with only the below columns selected 
  select(ID, Date, Year, Month, max_depth, temp_mean, salinity_mean, Light_mean, calanus_wc_I, calanus_wc_II, calanus_wc_III, calanus_wc_IV, calanus_wc_V, calanus_wc_Adult, lat, long) |>
  distinct() 

#Building the bins
station_bins <- station_data |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(actual_depth = list({
    end_val <- floor(max_depth / 5) * 5 - 2.5
    if (end_val < 2.5) 2.5 else seq(2.5, end_val, by = 5)
  })) |>
  unnest(actual_depth) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    perc_depth  = actual_depth / max_depth,
    Month       = factor(Month, levels = levels(df_vertical$Month)),
    Temp        = temp_mean,
    Salinity    = salinity_mean,
    Light       = Light_mean,
    time_of_day = mean(df_vertical$time_of_day, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

#Named list of models
models <- list(
  I     = WC_position_gam_I,
  II    = WC_position_gam_II,
  III   = WC_position_gam_III,
  IV    = WC_position_gam_IV,
  V     = WC_position_gam_V,
  Adult = WC_position_gam_Adult
)

#Function to predict + convert for one stage
predict_stage <- function(stage, model, bins) {
  wc_col <- paste0("calanus_wc_", stage)

  bins |>
    mutate(prop_cum_pred = predict(model, newdata = bins, type = "response")) |>
    arrange(ID, Date, actual_depth) |>
    group_by(ID, Date) |>
    mutate(
      prop_cum_mono = cummax(prop_cum_pred),
      prop_5m       = c(prop_cum_mono[1], diff(prop_cum_mono)) * 100,
      density_m3    = (prop_5m / 5) * .data[[wc_col]]
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(stage = stage)
}

#Run for all stages 
station_bins_all <- imap_dfr(models, \(m, stage) predict_stage(stage, m, station_bins))

sum(is.na(station_bins_all$prop_cum_pred))
```

```{r}
cal_per_ind <- c(I = 0.0074, II = 0.0428, III = 0.1494,
                 IV = 0.5999, V = 1.8601, Adult = 1.8626)

station_bins_all <- station_bins_all |>
  mutate(
    calories_per_individual = cal_per_ind[stage],
    ED_max_calories_m3      = density_m3 * calories_per_individual
  )

station_bins_all <- station_bins_all |>
  group_by(ID, Date, actual_depth) |>
  mutate(
    ED_total_calories_m3 = sum(ED_max_calories_m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    density_m3_total     = sum(density_m3, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
station_bins_total <- station_bins_all |>
  group_by(ID, Date, actual_depth) |>
  summarise(
    ED_max_calories_m3 = sum(ED_max_calories_m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    density_m3_total   = sum(density_m3, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(c(Year, Month, max_depth, perc_depth, Temp, Salinity, Light, lat, long),
           first),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

#Getting row with highest calorie 
```{r}
depth_of_Calmax <- station_bins_all |>                             #finding out which bin level has the highest energy level and putting it in depth_of_EDmax df
  group_by(ID, Date) |>                                       #grouping to work within each ID and Date
  slice_max(ED_max_calories_m3, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>        #getting only the row with the maximum energy 
  select(ID, Date, lat, long, Year, depth_of_max = actual_depth, ED_max_calories_m3, Month, max_depth) |>    
  ungroup()
```
